title: In-flight kernel switch causing KV-slot misalignment and subtle numeric scaling drift
creator: Marisol Vega
description: Summary: During high-concurrency workloads where the serving runtime dynamically switches between quantized int8 kernels and bf16 kernels mid-request, we observed rare cases of KV cache slot misalignment paired with a small but compounding floating-point scaling mismatch. Symptoms include duplicated tokens at the tail of long generations, subtle token shifts in otherwise deterministic prompts, and divergence between runs that were previously bit-equivalent. This appears after a kernel switch that happens while prefill and decode streams overlap for the same session (e.g., long-context chat where prefill continues while decode fetches KV slots).
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Deploy a model variant with both int8 and bf16 kernels enabled (quantization fallback enabled).
2) Configure worker pool with mixed kernel-capable GPUs and set kernel-swap threshold low to force in-flight switching.
3) Issue a long-context chat request that triggers background prefill writes while decode is reading KV (e.g., history length > 8k tokens, streaming enabled).
4) Run the same request multiple times under concurrency (10+ concurrent sessions).
5) Observe occasional generation mismatch: token duplication or shift in output.
Repro rate: ~1-2% on our perf harness on p4d cluster under synthetic load; increases with request concurrency and sequence length.
observed_behavior:
- Duplicated final token(s) in generation or an extra separator token.
- Non-deterministic divergence between consecutive identical requests.
- Small difference in softmax/attention logits (1e-5 to 1e-3) immediately after kernel-switch boundary in logs.
- KV index audit shows a hole or overlapping write in ~30% of affected traces.
expected_behavior: Kernel switching should be functionally transparent: no KV slot misalignment, no inter-run divergence, and numeric differences limited to acceptable roundoff that do not change argmax decisions for tokens.
investigation_notes:
- Initial alerts came from our production canary (canary-8) on 2026-02-09 after an infra change to lower kernel-swap latency.
- Collected 120 failing traces and 10k successful traces for comparison.
- Correlated failures with: (a) interleaved prefill writes overlapping decode reads, (b) kernel selection decision executed in worker thread A while worker B was performing decode on same session, (c) presence of small scheduling jitter (10-50us) at prefill/decode handoff.
- Binary search narrowed source to the kernel-selector + KV reservation code path introduced in PR #14290.
- Heap snapshots show KV ring index incremented twice in one code path when a kernel-swap callback raced with prefill completion.
- FP logs: scaling factor applied by int8-dequant path differs by ~1e-3 from bf16 kernel path in some tensor lanes; divergence amplified by attention softmax and causes different top-1 token in edge cases.
logs_samples:
[2026-02-09T21:34:12.831Z] session=abc123 kernel=bf16 decode_step=45 status=reading_kv idx=1023
[2026-02-09T21:34:12.840Z] session=abc123 kernel_switch=int8 reason=throughput_estimate
[2026-02-09T21:34:12.842Z] session=abc123 prefill_write idx=1023 -> idx=1024 (hole created)
[2026-02-09T21:34:12.846Z] session=abc123 decode_read idx=1024 value=... (unexpected)
Softmax-delta: 2.7e-4 on token logits at step 46
hypothesis: A race between the kernel-selector callback and the KV reservation/write path can cause the ring buffer index to be updated inconsistently. When the worker switches kernels mid-request, the dequant/scaling semantics differ slightly; combined with a mis-ordered KV index update this leads to reading stale/shifted KV slices and small numeric differences that in edge cases flip token selection. The root causes are (1) non-atomic KV slot reservation across kernel-change boundary and (2) missing normalization parity between int8 dequant path and bf16 kernels for cross-kernel handoff.
temporary_mitigation:
1) Disable dynamic in-flight kernel switching by default for affected model families (toggle via runtime flag: disable_inflight_kernel_swap=true).
2) Add a conservative lock around KV slot reservation code when kernel swap is pending.
3) Re-enable deterministic kernel selection in Dedicated clusters until fix is validated.
proposed_fixes:
1) Make KV slot reservation and index increment atomic with respect to kernel-switch events (use small critical section or CAS on the ring index).
2) Standardize scaling factors at kernel boundary: ensure int8->fp path applies the same normalization constants as bf16 kernel, add unit tests comparing per-lane post-attn sums.
3) Add scheduling barrier that drains prefill writes for the session before committing a kernel change for that session (prefer fence over global lock).
4) Add targeted regression tests in the perf harness that simulate interleaved prefill+decode with kernel-swap enabled.
